changes.title: Party join
items: A creature joining the party throws a little burst of amber confetti and sparkles, and does a happy hop
Guests at a picnic or the balloons stand side by side behind it, not in a heap
Party animals twinkle in warm amber, so a happy dancer never looks like one being hit

changes.title: Attack cues
items: A glint over a creature's head as it starts winding up a blow, dust kicked up behind a lunge, petals flying from a charging boar, a cold drift of motes round anything slowed, and a shockwave under a legend's blow
A legend no longer flashes the whole screen white when it's hit: its flash is half as strong, and the hit's star marks the blow

changes.title: Night palette
items: At night each area keeps its own colour: the moor's heather is violet-brown, the ravine is grey rock, the stone shrine pale flagstones
Grass and treetops are a dark blue-green at night, never lime
